aboutMe:
I started coding after high school and have been learning and building ever since. I enjoy solving complex problems and turning designs into responsive, visually thoughtful websites.

My early experience includes an internship at THtwin Innovation Lab and frontend development at Nawphire. I've built RESTful APIs, worked with relational databases, and deployed applications with Heroku and Vercel.

I'm currently building projects in TypeScript and learning Rust to deepen my understanding of systems programming. Away from the keyboard, I play chess to sharpen my problem-solving and rational thinking.
